verses.1: After this, I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth. They kept control over the four winds of the earth, so that no wind could blow across the earth, the sea, or any tree.
verses.2: And we saw another angel coming from the east, carrying the seal of God’s life. He cried out with a loud voice to the four angels who were given authority to harm the earth and the sea.
verses.3: Say: “Do not harm the land, nor the sea, nor the trees. Until we have sealed up the servants of our God on their thresholds.”
verses.4: And I heard the number of those who were buried: sixty-four thousand six hundred. They were all from all the tribes of Israel.
verses.5: From the tribe of Judah, twelve thousand people were buried. From the tribe of Ruben, twelve thousand people were buried. From the tribe of Gad, twelve thousand people were buried.
verses.6: From the tribe of Asher, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Neftali, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Manasseh, twelve thousand.
verses.7: From the tribe of Simeon, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Levi, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Issachar, twelve thousand.
verses.8: Twelve thousand from the tribe of Zebulun, twelve thousand from the tribe of Joseph, and twelve thousand from the tribe of Benjamin were buried alive.
verses.9: After that, I saw a very large crowd. No one was able to count them; they came from all nations, tribes, peoples, and languages. They stood in front of the throne, as well as in front of the bull. They wore white clothes, and vines were also around their wrists.
verses.10: And they shout with a loud voice, “Salvation to our God, who sits on the throne and also to the lamb.”
verses.11: And all the angels stood in a circle around the throne, along with the priests and the four animals. They fell down before the throne, face downward, and bowed down to God.
verses.12: They said, “Amens! Praise, honor, wisdom, thanksgiving, respect, power, and glory to our God for all ages to come.” Amens.
verses.13: And one of the elders said to me, “Are these those who are wearing white garments? Where did they come from?”
verses.14: And I said to him, “Lord, you know.” He also said to me, “These are those who come from great sorrow. They have washed their clothes and they are now covered in the blood of sheep.”
verses.15: Therefore, they are allowed to stand before the throne of God. They worship Him day and night in His temple. And those who sit on the throne will arrange a platform for them.
verses.16: They will not suffer anymore, nor will they be harmed. The sun will not shine upon them anymore, and no harm will happen to them either.
verses.17: For the ram, which is located in the middle of the throne, will lead them to a source of living water. And the God will remove all tears from their eyes.
